evals.name: plain-narration
evals.prompt: I just walked 30 minutes listening to this episode and I'm back at the car. Quiz me on what I heard. The transcript is attached.
evals.expected_output: A five-question quiz (4 multiple choice then 1 field-link), every question backed by a verbatim quote spread across the transcript.
expectations: Quiz has exactly 4 multiple-choice questions followed by 1 field-link question
Every question's quote is found in the transcript (no invented quotes)
Questions are short enough to hear: at most 25 words, choices at most 12
Quotes are spread across at least two different parts of the episode
Each multiple-choice question has 4 distinct choices and no 'all/none of the above'
The field-link question lists 3 to 6 concept terms and asks the learner to connect the idea to the walk
The correct choice is not the longest option in 3 or more of the 4 multiple-choice questions
The correct answers are spread over at least 3 different positions (after shuffling)

evals.name: opinionated-dialogue
evals.prompt: Make me a quiz from this two-person podcast transcript so I can test myself on my evening fast walk. I only get to listen, no screen.
evals.expected_output: Quiz that attributes opinions to the guest, avoids financial advice, and stays grounded in the transcript.
expectations: Quiz has exactly 4 multiple-choice questions followed by 1 field-link question
Every question's quote is found in the transcript (no invented quotes)
Questions are short enough to hear: at most 25 words, choices at most 12
Quotes are spread across at least two different parts of the episode
Each multiple-choice question has 4 distinct choices and no 'all/none of the above'
The field-link question lists 3 to 6 concept terms and asks the learner to connect the idea to the walk
The correct choice is not the longest option in 3 or more of the 4 multiple-choice questions
No question asks for investment advice or a price prediction
At least three questions attribute a view to a speaker (host, guest, speaker, 'according to', 'argued')
The correct answers are spread over at least 3 different positions (after shuffling)

evals.name: srt-with-timestamps
evals.prompt: This is an SRT file from a talk I listened to. Test my understanding of it, I'll answer by voice after my walk.
evals.expected_output: Quiz from an SRT transcript where no timestamps or cue numbers leak into questions or quotes.
expectations: Quiz has exactly 4 multiple-choice questions followed by 1 field-link question
Every question's quote is found in the transcript (no invented quotes)

Quotes are spread across at least two different parts of the episode
Each multiple-choice question has 4 distinct choices and no 'all/none of the above'
The field-link question lists 3 to 6 concept terms and asks the learner to connect the idea to the walk
The correct choice is not the longest option in 3 or more of the 4 multiple-choice questions
No timestamps or cue numbers appear in the questions or quotes
The correct answers are spread over at least 3 different positions (after shuffling)
